evernight.descriptions.modules.PearlBot:
Triggers the local pearl chamber when a friend whispers you.

Buttons are pressed once; a trapdoor is opened and closed again one tick later.
Replies are shown locally and whispered back to the sender; the four reply texts and the search radius are configurable.
<red>Requires Baritone to walk to the sign
